scripts.name: STRATUS - GCP - Exfiltrate Compute Disk by sharing it
scripts.description:
Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation technique for GCP.

Exfiltrate Compute Disk by sharing it

Exfiltrates a Compute Disk by sharing with a fictitious attacker account. The attacker could then create a snapshot of the disk in their GCP project. Warm-up: - Create a Compute Disk Detonation: - Set the IAM policy of the disk so that the attacker account has permissions to read the disk in their own project !!! note Since the target email must exist for this attack simulation to work, Stratus Red Team grants the role to

Morgana executes the official Stratus technique using an isolated MORGANA_TEST_ID correlation ID. Prerequisite infrastructure is handled by Stratus warmup. Cleanup uses the same correlation ID.
scripts.command:
# Stratus Red Team — Exfiltrate Compute Disk by sharing it
# Correlation ID = Morgana Test ID for Detection Fabric correlation
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-$(uuidgen 2>/dev/null || cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid 2>/dev/null || echo manual)}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if [ -n "#{stratus_gcp_project}" ]; then export GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT="#{stratus_gcp_project}"; fi

# Select Stratus binary for this Agent OS
if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
  chmod +x "$STRATUS_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

echo "[INFO] Stratus Red Team: technique=gcp.exfiltration.share-compute-disk"
echo "[INFO] Correlation ID: $STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID"

# Warmup + Detonate
"$STRATUS_BIN" detonate gcp.exfiltration.share-compute-disk
EXIT_CODE=$?

echo "[INFO] Detonation complete: exit=$EXIT_CODE technique=gcp.exfiltration.share-compute-disk"
# Emit structured result
echo "MORGANA_RESULT_METADATA={\"provider\":\"stratus-red-team\",\"technique_id\":\"gcp.exfiltration.share-compute-disk\",\"correlation_id\":\"$STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID\",\"exit_code\":$EXIT_CODE}"
exit $EXIT_CODE
scripts.cleanup_command:
# Stratus Red Team cleanup — uses SAME correlation ID as detonation
# MORGANA_TEST_ID must match the value used during detonate
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-manual}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
fi

"$STRATUS_BIN" cleanup gcp.exfiltration.share-compute-disk
CLEANUP_EXIT=$?
echo "[INFO] Cleanup complete: exit=$CLEANUP_EXIT technique=gcp.exfiltration.share-compute-disk"
exit $CLEANUP_EXIT
